definitions.explanation: The everyday shortened name for the photo- and video-sharing app Instagram. Standard in casual speech and online.

examples.japanese: インスタに{写真|しゃしん}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I posted a photo on Instagram.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}、インスタで{見|み}て{気|き}になってたんだ。
examples.english: I'd been curious about this place after seeing it on Instagram.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{写真|しゃしん}をインスタにアップしたら、たくさんいいねがついた。
examples.english: When I uploaded my trip photos to Instagram, they got a lot of likes.

notes:
Casual clipping of インスタグラム (Instagram). The full form is rare in speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- インスタに{上|あ}げる / アップする: to post to Instagram
- インスタ{映|ば}え: looking good in an Instagram photo; photogenic
- インスタのフォロワー: Instagram followers

USAGE:
インスタ{映|ば}え ("Instagrammable") became a buzzword and is now widely used even apart from the app itself.
